reviews.title: I was given misinformation from the front desk receptionist, which made me not want to come back.
reviews.text: The location of the place was great and convenient. It was right next to a mall and not too far from restaurants and other places we wanted to visit. / The front staff employee was not kind. I was given misinformation when I was checking into my room and was charged an early fee when I checked out. I specifically informed the front desk employee that I didn't want to check into my room because I didn't want to pay a $100 early check-in fee, and waited until 12:15 pm to go into my room. Once I received my bill, I informed the same front desk employee that I didn't go into my room until after check-in time, and she still charged it to my credit card. I was told that she wasn't able to put it back onto my card. I informed her that I would never come back to that hotel.

reviews.title: wonderfull
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Caesars Republic Scottsdale, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warm hospitality and outstanding service.

The hotel's decor is modern and stylish, creating a luxurious yet comfortable atmosphere. My room was impeccably clean, well-appointed, and offered a beautiful view of the surrounding area. The bed was incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep.

One of the highlights of my stay was the dining experience. The on-site restaurant served a variety of delicious dishes, each prepared with the utmost care and attention to detail. The staff was attentive and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations and ensuring that every meal was enjoyable.

The amenities at Caesars Republic Scottsdale are top-notch. I particularly enjoyed the rooftop pool, which provided a perfect spot to relax and take in the stunning views of Scottsdale. The fitness center was also well-equipped, allowing me to maintain my workout routine during my stay.

Overall, my stay at Caesars Republic Scottsdale exceeded my expectations. The combination of excellent service, luxurious accommodations, and fantastic amenities made for a truly memorable experience. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a premium stay in Scottsdale.
